**In one line**: Claude maker Anthropic reportedly posted its first-ever profit as revenue surged, and laid out a goal of reaching $200 billion in revenue by 2028, according to Chosunbiz.

### Key points
- Anthropic reportedly reached its **first profit** since founding.
- The turn was driven by **soaring revenue**, attributed to growing demand for its enterprise API and Claude subscriptions.
- The company set a target of **$200 billion in revenue by 2028**.

### Why it matters
Most large AI companies remain in the red under heavy training and inference costs, so a swing to profit signals that generative-AI businesses can actually be viable. It also offers a read on Anthropic's financial footing as it competes with OpenAI at the frontier-model level.
